description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing delegation credentials, including validation, error handling, and data sanitization.

classes.name: InvalidServiceAccountKeyError
classes.description: Custom error class for invalid service account keys.

methods.name: ensureDelegationCredentialNotAlreadyConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a delegation credential is already configured for the domain in the current or other organizations.

methods.name: parseServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Validates and parses a service account key JSON object.

methods.name: handleDelegationCredentialError
methods.description: Handles errors related to delegation credentials, throwing appropriate TRPCErrors.

methods.name: ensureNoServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Removes the serviceAccountKey field from a delegation credential object.
